svg.aria-label: Quadshield — Philippine National Police. Real-time emergency dispatch: Laravel Reverb WebSockets for call signalling, LiveKit WebRTC for sub-second two-way voice, an ESP32 IoT panic button with captive-portal provisioning, and an offline-first Flutter app backed by a local queue — validated with automated testing.
